# Detroit Pistons Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

Locked On Fantasy Basketball, 2026-10-03, 33:09. https://youtu.be/_O9pc_u5vH0

## Summary

Josh Lloyd previews the Detroit Pistons for the 2026/27 fantasy season, after Jalen Duren's contract holdout ended. He expects last season's starting five to return: Cade Cunningham, Duncan Robinson, Ausar Thompson, John Collins and Jalen Duren. He says Cade is not a lock at pick 5 and is better taken around 6 to 9. Duren is a fair third to fourth round pick, and an ESPN rank of 23 is too high. Ausar Thompson is his top target on the team despite points and threes damage. Duren is his biggest fade, Daniss Jenkins is his late swing, and Paul Reed is his stash. Collins is fine around rounds 9 to 10 in category leagues. Robinson and Isaiah Joe are only three-point streamers. The schedule is decent and there are no injury concerns.
